name: ats_url preferred and trimmed
spec: Returns `ats_url` with surrounding whitespace removed when it is present and not blank

name: blank ats_url falls back to url
spec: otherwise `url` with surrounding whitespace removed

name: empty-string ats_url falls back to url
spec: when it is present and not blank; otherwise `url` with surrounding whitespace removed

name: None ats_url falls back to url
spec: otherwise `url` with surrounding whitespace removed; otherwise "" (missing keys, None values, None job)

name: missing ats_url key uses url
spec: otherwise `url` with surrounding whitespace removed

name: only ats_url present, url key missing
spec: Returns `ats_url` with surrounding whitespace removed when it is present and not blank

name: None job returns empty string
spec: otherwise "" (missing keys, None values, None job)

name: empty job dict returns empty string
spec: otherwise "" (missing keys, None values, None job)

name: greenhouse.io case-insensitive
spec: Case-insensitive. Checked in this order; the first substring found wins: greenhouse.io → greenhouse

name: gh_jid parameter on company domain
spec: gh_jid= → greenhouse

name: lever posting url
spec: lever.co → lever

name: ashby posting url
spec: ashbyhq.com → ashby

name: myworkdayjobs host
spec: myworkdayjobs.com → workday

name: icims parameter on own domain
spec: icims=1 → icims

name: workable posting url
spec: workable.com → workable

name: SuccessFactors RMK page on company domain, trailing slash
spec: a SuccessFactors RMK career page on a company's own domain → successfactors. Its shape is scheme://host/job/<slug>/<id>/

name: SuccessFactors RMK with one locale segment
spec: Between the host and "job" there may be at most ONE extra path segment (a locale or region, e.g. /NorthAmerica/job/...)

name: SuccessFactors RMK followed by query
spec: the URL may end there or continue with ?query or #fragment

name: SuccessFactors shape with two extra segments does not count
spec: two or more extra segments do not count

name: builtin.com never counts as SuccessFactors
spec: Hosts builtin.com and linkedin.com never count as SuccessFactors this way

name: SuccessFactors shape with 7-digit id does not count
spec: where <id> is 8 to 12 digits

name: lever_parse basic posting url
spec: A Lever posting URL is jobs.lever.co/<site>/<uuid>

name: lever_parse lowercases uuid, keeps site case
spec: it is returned in lower case. The site keeps its original case.

name: lever_parse eu host with /apply suffix
spec: jobs.lever.co/<site>/<uuid> or jobs.eu.lever.co/<site>/<uuid>, optionally followed by /apply or anything else

name: lever_parse percent-decoded trailing space in site
spec: The URL is percent-decoded first, and spaces right before or after <site> are ignored (jobs.lever.co/Xpansiv%20/<uuid> → site "Xpansiv")

name: lever_parse other host returns None
spec: Not a Lever posting (other host, no uuid, malformed uuid) → None

name: lever_parse malformed uuid returns None
spec: <uuid> is the standard 8-4-4-4-12 hex form ... Not a Lever posting (other host, no uuid, malformed uuid) → None
